comments.author: @barker3877
comments.text:
Regrettably, this video includes some inaccuracies and totally ignores the fact until 1827  all these territories had been a part of Iranian empire for thousands of years.  Darial pass was built during the Iranian king Dariush thousands of years ago whose name reflects the pass’ name.  The Derbent (aka Darband) fortification was built by the Sassanid kings of Iran, along with other fortifications in current Dagestan.  The Ateshgah (correct name Atashkadeh) in Republic of Azerbaijan is actually a Zoroastrian sacred Fire Temple; it looks ridiculous with those culturally insensitive figures put under it.    

Mount Elbrus was actually named Alborz and it is the little Alborz, the brother of the main Alborz mountain chain inside current Iran.

This video is NOT a transparent non-politicized review of Kafkaz territory.  Had the makers bothered to looked at Vladi Kafkaz the capital of the Ossetia whose people are 100% Iranian (Irooni) and unfortunately half of Ossetia is occupied by Georgian (South Ossetia) and the other half is occupied by Russians (north Ossetia)…… so many other things that could be said in this video which was missed.  That being said, all people of Kafkaz are fantastic, resourceful and brave people who have been living in these unique territories for centuries.
